topic: Photograph the rule sheet of a new board game and have AI explain setup, turns, a read-aloud version for kids, and easy-to-miss rules
text:
If a new board game came out after Thanksgiving dinner and nobody wants to read the rule sheet, snap a clear photo of it.

"Here are the rules for [game name] in this photo. Explain setup, then how a turn works, in plain steps. Add a short version to read aloud to kids ages [ages], and list rules that are easy to miss."

Tap the plus or paperclip to add the photo, and include both sides.

Which game comes out first when family visits?
